verdict.rationale: PayPal's agentic commerce services (Store Sync, ACP/UCP integrations, agent toolkit) are proprietary hosted APIs and closed-source integrations; the agent-toolkit SDK is published on npm/PyPI but no evidence indicates an open-source license for its source, and core commerce services (Store Sync, cart API, MCP server backend) are entirely closed, gated behind forms and merchant accounts. No evidence pack item shows an open-license repository for the product's source.
